text: The elemental ATK-vs-DEF formula is fully recovered, and nobody in this packet claimed it. Each element channel is mitigated independently by the matching elemental DEF, floored at 1 whenever the attacker carried any of that element (so an elemental hit always chips at least 1 per channel) and at 0 otherwise; the four channels are then summed with the physical damage into a single HP deduction. The defender's elemental DEF stats are themselves derived from the COUNTER element's ATK stat, which is the code-side form of the element wheel.

text: The open question behind the packet's hp-less-combat-rows claim is answerable and I answered it. Spawn level for combat NPCs comes from the QUEST WAVE, not from npcdata. NPCManager.as:110-131 reads wave[i].enemy[j].lvl into new NPCHolder(id,fatal,xpos,lvl); :407/411/433/437 pass npcHolder.getLvl() into createEnemy/createObjective, which call actor.setLevel(lvl) when lvl != 0 (:877-879, :931-934). 160 of the 169 <enemy> blocks in questdata.xml carry <lvl>. Concretely: Gojo Takamori npc 190 spawns at lvl 25 (questdata.xml:26101 id, :26105 lvl) and npc 191 at 35 (:25862 / :25866); Magoichi npc 188 at 35, npc 810 at 27. Friendlies never need one — FriendlyElite.as:70 and FriendlyArcher.as:58 call setLevel(StatsManager.getLevel()), so allies scale to the player, and 7 of the 12 skill-carrying hp-less rows are ai 30 / ai 34 = FriendlyElite / FriendlyArcher (NPCManager.as:608-621). NPC.setLevel at :239-259 then rescales damage, defense and maxhp by lvl/level and hard-clamps all three to 1 when lvl <= 10.
